question: What attainment makes a practitioner dear to the yoginīs?
premises: Enjoyment and liberation together constitute a great accomplishment
Such accomplishment relates to the yoginīs
This attainment can make one dear to them
inference: Through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation, one may become dear to the yoginīs
plain_english: Through the great accomplishment of enjoyment and liberation, one may become dear to the yoginīs.
